beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Outside Bethlehem, shepherds were keeping watch over their flocks by night — ordinary men working the late shift, about the lowest job there was.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Suddenly an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord blazed all around. They were terrified. And the angel said:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people. For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Listen to who he says it is for. Not for the palace. Not for the temple. For you — the men out in the field on the night shift.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And in a moment the one angel became a vast multitude of the heavenly host, filling the whole sky.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That is what the sky said. Not a warning. Not a demand. Peace, and good will — heaven's opinion of the human race, said out loud over a sheep field.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: When the angels had gone away into heaven, the shepherds said to one another:

beats.text: Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They did not stand around discussing it. They came with haste into the town.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They found Mary and Joseph, and the baby lying in the manger — exactly as they had been told.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: There he was: the Saviour of the world, a tiny newborn asleep in a feed trough, wrapped in strips of cloth.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The shepherds could not keep it in. They went out glorifying and praising God, telling everyone they met what they had seen and heard.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

timing.text: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: In a story full of people shouting, Luke stops to tell you about the one person who said nothing. She gathered it all up — the angels, the shepherds, the trough, the strangers at the door in the middle of the night — and she held on to it, and turned it over, for the rest of her life.

card.text: The first birth announcement in history went to night-shift workers on a hillside. Good news of great joy, for all people. Including you.
